item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 28/May/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure will form over the northern part of southern China and move southwards today. There will be showers and squally thunderstorms over the coastal areas later today and tomorrow. With the trough of low pressure moving into the northern part of the South China Sea in the following couple of days, showers will ease off over the coast of Guangdong. Meanwhile, a strong easterly airstream will affect the region. A southwesterly airstream is expected to bring hot and showery weather to the coast of southern China early next week.

Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers. More showers and a few squally thunderstorms later.
